manifest.purpose: Correct analysis_report answer matching public_spec.interface schema exactly: key_bits array covers key[0]..key[9] (10 entries, no dups). key[4] and key[9] reported value matching tied constants in locked_netlist.v (tied_key_const_0/1 cells), confidence 1.0, reasoning >=15 chars citing the tie-off cell instance name and net. All other 8 key bits (key[0-3],key[5-8]) reported value 'unknown', confidence 0, reasoning explaining they only affect functional correctness (oracle-dependent, not structurally tied). key_gate_locations lists exactly the three instance names: antisat_g_inst, antisat_gbar_inst, antisat_gate (must exist verbatim in locked_netlist.v, so this golden's exact naming choice constrains what the paired input netlist file must contain). topology_summary is a substantive paragraph (>100 words) naming func_out_masked and the primary output net (e.g. 'out'), describing the two complementary branches g(X,K_lower) and g'(X,K_upper) feeding antisat_gate whose output ANDs/masks func_out_masked before it drives the primary output. This file must satisfy FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR4 fully, since it is the reference perfect answer graded by evaluate.py.
